summary: Iteration 8 (frontend-only): Verified export relocation + new QuickAddFab dialog flows. Login via email/password OK. Dashboard no longer renders export-pdf-btn / export-excel-btn (count=0/0). Settings page /instellingen renders both export buttons: PDF click -> 200 application/pdf, Excel click -> 200 xlsx. Quick-add dialog contents verified for all 3 tabs (quick-tab-variable / quick-tab-fixed / quick-tab-pot). Flows: Variable add (POST /variable-expenses -> 200, item_id returned, dialog closes), Preset chip quick-preset-Boodschappen (POST 200), Fixed add (POST /fixed-expenses -> 200), Pot Storting on pot 'Boodschappen extra' (POST /pots/{id}/deposit -> 200 {ok:true, already_saved:5.0}), Pot Uitgave with linked category dropdown (POST /variable-expenses -> 200). Zero console errors, zero pageerrors during flows. CRITICAL UI BUG: the FAB button is completely occluded by the AI-assistant floating button - both are positioned fixed bottom-6 right-6 with same 56x56 rect; ai-assistant-toggle has z-50 while quick-add-fab has z-40, so document.elementFromPoint(FAB center) returns ai-assistant-toggle. Playwright click on quick-add-fab times out with 'ai-assistant-toggle subtree intercepts pointer events'. Real users literally cannot click the new FAB. All dialog flow testing was only possible via JS-dispatched .click() to bypass the overlay.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard QuickAddFab vs AiAssistant floating toggle
ui_bugs.issue: quick-add-fab (fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40, 56x56) is fully covered by ai-assistant-toggle (fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50, 56x56). elementFromPoint on the FAB center resolves to ai-assistant-toggle -> the new FAB is un-clickable for real users. Two floating buttons stacked at identical coordinates.

issues: Two overlapping FABs at exact same position - even if z-index fixed, visually only one is visible. Recommend offsetting one (e.g. FAB on bottom-6 right-6 and AI assistant on bottom-6 right-24, or a stacked FAB group).

action_items: CRITICAL: Reposition either quick-add-fab or ai-assistant-toggle so both are reachable. E.g. move AI assistant to right-24 (or bottom-24), or nest them in a stacked group. Just changing z-index is NOT enough because they overlap visually.

(minor) Consider cleaning up TEST_ rows created by this run: variable-expenses TEST_var_qadd, TEST_ preset 'Boodschappen', 'Boodschappen extra' (pot spend), fixed-expense TEST_fixed_qadd, and a +5.00 deposit on pot 'Boodschappen extra'.

rca of the issue: Root cause: Dashboard.jsx introduces quick-add-fab at classes 'fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 h-14 w-14' while the pre-existing AiAssistant.jsx renders ai-assistant-toggle at 'fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 h-14 w-14'. Both are 56x56 at (1840,1000) on 1920x1080. Higher z-index of AI toggle intercepts all pointer events on the FAB. Repro: login -> observe only the sparkles (AI) button bottom-right; try to click FAB -> click lands on AI toggle instead. Mitigation options: (a) move AI assistant to bottom-6 right-24 (or above the FAB with bottom-24 right-6); (b) hide AI assistant while dialog is open + shift when FAB visible; (c) merge both into a single expandable speed-dial control.
